recentItems.title: ChiaroScuro | Official Trailer | Netflix
recentItems.description:
In Rome, surrounded by the city's most breathtaking palaces and churches, a serial killer is choosing victims inspired by famous works of art. Cosmo Speranza, an art advisor with an infallible eye for spotting forgeries (and the son of a notorious forger who took his own life) is forced to team up with police inspector Angelo Tiberi, who knows nothing about art. An unlikely but effective investigative duo, hunting a killer whose crimes will drag Cosmo back into the unsolved mystery of his father's death.

ChiaroScuro, the new Italian crime series set in the art world, streaming November 11, only on Netflix.

Starring Pierpaolo Spollon, Andrea Lattanzi, Matilde Gioli, Romana Maggiora Vergano, Aurora Giovinazzo, with Paz Vega and Alessandro Preziosi.

🎨 A mystery where art, deception and murder collide
🔍 Every crime scene is a clue, every painting a message
👀 An investigative duo who couldn't be more different, or more effective together
